text:
maya: FYI — partner submitted a candidate model named Lumen-13B. Decoder-only, ~13B params, FP16 pretrained. Asking for an intake + bring-up plan (perf, quant, quality, catalog, announce). Can we run a quick sweep this week?

sam: I can own the quant/perf sweeps. What are the success criteria?

maya: Key asks: a) FP16 baseline numbers, b) q8_0 / q4x / q4_0 perf + quality comparisons at seq=2048, c) p99 latency target <130ms on our A100-equivalent nodes if possible, d) catalog entry & docs snippet, e) announcement schedule.

alex: I'll draft the model catalog entry and quickstart sample. Need provenance, license, recommended quant configs, and a short safety notes section.

jin: Product wants a staged rollout: internal beta next Tue, public docs + blog ~2 weeks after. We need eval pass and safety signoff before internal beta.

qa-lisa: I'll prepare the eval suites (summaries, instruction-following, code, hallucination tests). Will need quantized binaries to run—please push artifacts to /mnt/artifacts/lumen-13b/ when ready.

sam: Plan: FP16 baseline -> q8_0 -> q4x -> q4_0. Use our perf harness: eng-ml/perf/runner. Quick example quant config I'll use for initial run:
```json
{"format": "q4x", "calibration": "per-layer", "clip_zero": false, "seq_len": 2048, "batch": 8}
```
I'll test throughput + p50/p95/p99 and token/sec.

ops-bot: Reserved 2 dev GPUs (a100-dev-02, a100-dev-03) for eng-ml Thu 10:00-12:00 PST.

deploy-bot: Canary window available Fri 03:00 UTC. To schedule canary, attach a canary.json with route: 5% -> lumen-13b-q8_0.

alex: For catalog tags I'm thinking: ["general-purpose", "3rd-party", "quant-friendly", "low-cost"]. Not instruction-tuned, so don't tag as "instruction-tuned". Will draft entry and link.

sam: Quick note from past runs: q4x gave ~1.7-1.9x token/sec vs q8_0 on similar models but sometimes increased hallucination on tight instruction prompts — we'll quantify with Lisa's suites.

qa-lisa: I'll run the 10 evaluation sets (incl. rouge, sacrebleu, instruction-adherence, factuality probes). ETA: initial matrix by EOD Thu.

maya: License check — partner claims permissive commercial license (MIT-compatible). Alex, please paste the license text in the catalog. Also need a short privacy statement (no private corpus).

alex: Will add license snippet + provenance link in the catalog draft. Will also include the minimal SDK example: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="lumen-13b-q8_0", prompt="Summarize...", max_tokens=256)
print(resp.text)
```

jin: Marketing needs a one-line blurb + three numbers: (latency p99 @2048), (cost delta vs baseline), (quality delta vs FP16). We can fill placeholders until sweeps complete.

maya: Owners summary: sam -> perf/quant, alex -> docs/catalog, qa-lisa -> evals, jin -> announce. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu after Lisa posts the eval matrix if there are regressions.

sam: Link to experiment sheet: https://redwood/gists/lumen-13b-sweeps (I'll update with run IDs).

qa-lisa: If we see regression >5% in instruction-following for q4 variants we should hold public launch. Will flag in the matrix.

alex: Draft catalog entry will live in docs/models/lumen-13b.md and I'll open a PR once I have license + sample outputs.

ops-bot: Note: please label artifacts with run metadata: model=lumen-13b, quant=format, seed, date.

deploy-bot: When ready for canary, post a PR with canary.json and ping me. I will schedule the rollout.

maya: Cool. If anyone hits a blocker (license, regressions, infra) call it out here. Otherwise proceed and report initial results by Thu EOD. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

alex: On it — will post draft by tomorrow morning.

qa-lisa: Will post eval matrix here when done.

jin: Thanks all — keep updates brief in this thread so we have a single source of truth.

maya: Adding this to next week's eng-ml agenda. Closing the intake thread but leaving it open for updates.
